name: Animalia Intelligence
source:
Rise and shine, dutiful worker! A new day is a new chance to help out your Parents!

Animalia Intelligence is a short game about uplifted animals helping out their human benefactors. Experience the world from the point of view of a small helper (or in this case, two small helpers) and remember- you owe them everything.

[Edited from [url=https://biteyferret.itch.io/animalia-intelligence]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
崛起吧，尽职的工人！新的一天是帮助父母的新机会！

《Animalia Intelligence》是一款关于积极向上的动物帮助人类恩人的短游戏。从一个小帮手（或者在本例中是两个小帮手）的角度体验世界，并记住——你欠他们一切。

[编辑自[url=https://biteyferret.itch.io/animalia-intelligence]itch.io[/url]]
